| **Assessed** | 2026-11-27 |

AI adds a full point a year to productivity growth, GDP is 35% higher after 30 years, but unemployment rises 2 points, participation falls 4 points and all gains go to top-quintile capital owners. Light taxation of capital limits the budget gain.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 2 | Permanently displaced workers lose income, purpose and social contact amid ongoing weak labour demand, while those who keep their jobs see living standards unchanged. |
| Affordable essentials | 2 | Falling employment cuts employer-sponsored health insurance and many people will want eldercare and be unable to afford it. |
| Reliable safety net | 2 | Programmes built for short spells meet permanent displacement, and people out of work for years would get smaller Social Security benefits unless the formula changes. |
| Responsive government | 2 | Capital owners with a much larger income share would presumably gain more political power, and vested interests could foreclose policy options. |
| Time for what matters |  | Not addressed: earlier retirement and shorter workweeks appear only as policy options, not as part of the scenario. |
